tasks.title: Endgame signal only
tasks.finish: src/endgame.py emits a signal when a fixture price is between 0.98 and 0.99 and the market ends within 48 hours. It never emits a fill or an order. pytest passes with no network and no credentials. config/risk.toml is unchanged.

tasks.title: Offline Brier proposal
tasks.finish: src/quant.py scores a local fixture with Brier mean((p-y)^2) and emits at most one proposal. It does not edit config/risk.toml or any size cap. pytest passes offline. No network and no credentials.

tasks.title: SportsDevig signal only
tasks.finish: src/sports_devig.py removes the overround from a two-way decimal-odds fixture and emits a signal only if fair probability exceeds market price plus slippage. No fill, no order, no network. config/risk.toml is unchanged.

tasks.title: Scanner filter, long-tail band, keyset paging
tasks.order_note: Operator ordered this task ahead of G on 2026-10-08. G and H (SportsDevig) were already done, so I is the first todo. Merging PR #2 is the human add.
tasks.finish: src/scanner.py walks public Gamma /markets/keyset, filters by min_liquidity_usd and max_spread from config/risk.toml plus expiry, one-sided and 0.03-0.97 long-tail rules, fails closed on missing, boolean, non-finite or invalid keys, stops on a repeated cursor or a page with no new markets, writes all passing markets to data/markets.jsonl and only the top 50 to the bus, exits 1/2/3 without writing on failure. Public run 2026-10-08 exit 0 scanned=15360 passed=8659 bus_signals=50 stop=exhausted. pytest passed offline. config/risk.toml unchanged.

tasks.title: public_get retry/backoff; scanner exits 3 on network failure
tasks.finish: src/podlib.py public_get retries transient network/TLS errors (URLError, ssl.SSLError incl. SSL EOF, ConnectionResetError, socket timeouts, HTTP 5xx) PUBLIC_GET_ATTEMPTS=3 times with 0.5 s exponential backoff, never retries HTTP 4xx, and raises PublicGetError when every attempt fails. src/scanner.py stops the walk with stop_reason network_error and main() exits 3 (paging incomplete) without writing, instead of crashing with exit 1. Offline tests mock urlopen and never sleep. config/risk.toml is unchanged.
